fields.description: How an extracted value is resolved to a Frappe Link. Exact matches only one unique candidate; Search proposes candidates but never approves them automatically.
fields.label: Resolver

fields.description: Comma-separated fields on the linked DocType, e.g. name,supplier_name,tax_id. Only real searchable fields are used.
fields.label: Resolver Match Fields

fields.description: Optional fixed JSON filters applied to every candidate lookup. Extracted/model data cannot override these filters.
fields.label: Resolver Filters (JSON)

fields.description: Minimum model confidence before this field may be auto-approved. Verified source evidence is still mandatory.
fields.label: Minimum Confidence

fields.description: Allow verified values above the configured threshold to be approved automatically. Disable for accounting or policy-sensitive fields.
fields.label: Allow Auto Approval

fields.description: Learn this resolved value only from reviewer-confirmed edits. Model output alone never trains memory.
fields.label: Enable Scoped Memory

fields.description: Comma-separated target fields forming the memory scope, e.g. company,supplier. Empty means target-DocType global scope.
fields.label: Memory Scope Fields

fields.description: Repeated independent reviewer confirmations required before memory can resolve automatically.
fields.label: Promotion Confirmations
